title: Tencents Hunyuan 3D-2: Creating games and 3D assets just got even better!
author: fisj

comments.author: __generic
comments.body: I've been messing around with this.  Good luck animating any characters or cleaning up any models that are beyond basic shapes.  Its creates a fuck ton of unusual vertices , faces, etc.   The blender automated tools like decimate dont even really help.
